summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct-public-company universe for the AI power constraint node using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane anchors are nuclear/power asset owners with disclosed hyperscaler PPAs. Underfollowed lane prioritizes electrical construction, data-center power installation, transmission/distribution, and substation-capacity service providers that are closer to permitting, interconnection, and execution bottlenecks than to AI headlines. No buy/sell view is implied. Expanded the underfollowed lane for AI-linked power and interconnection constraints. The strongest directly evidenced additions are Powell Industries for medium-voltage/custom electrical distribution tied to data-center orders, IES Holdings for data-center infrastructure and custom power solutions, and MYR Group for transmission, distribution, substation, and commercial electrical contracting. Centrus is included as a nuclear-fuel bottleneck hypothesis because HALEU/enrichment capacity is upstream of advanced nuclear generation that could become relevant to long-duration AI power demand, but its AI linkage remains indirect and must be verified through reactor/customer commercialization evidence. Expanded the underfollowed discovery lane for the AI power/interconnection chokepoint. The strongest non-megacap mappings found in this pass are specialty electrical contractors, switchgear/electrical distribution vendors, and niche engineered nuclear/energy components suppliers.
